title: Game Arcade: Modernize Home banners and replace game icons with realistic visuals

requirements.summary: Modernize the Home banner carousel visuals while keeping exactly 3 slides and preserving existing banner image paths and carousel behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: The Home banner carousel still shows exactly 3 slides (Ludo, Chess, Carrom) and continues to auto-rotate and allow manual navigation (arrows + dots).

The carousel continues to reference these exact paths: /assets/generated/home-banner-ludo.dim_1600x600.png, /assets/generated/home-banner-chess.dim_1600x600.png, /assets/generated/home-banner-carrom.dim_1600x600.png.
The new banner images look more realistic and modern than the current ones (no cartoonish/flat placeholders).

file_operations.description: Replace the existing banner asset with a modern, realistic premium-looking Ludo banner while keeping the exact filename/path.
Replace the existing banner asset with a modern, realistic premium-looking Chess banner while keeping the exact filename/path.
Replace the existing banner asset with a modern, realistic premium-looking Carrom banner while keeping the exact filename/path.
Refine carousel presentation styling (no changes to slide count, image paths, auto-rotation timing, arrows, or dots) to better showcase the updated modern banner designs.

requirements.summary: Replace HomeScreen game icon images (Ludo/Chess/Carrom) with realistic modern icons while preserving existing icon asset paths and card layout.
acceptanceCriteria: HomeScreen continues to reference these exact paths: /assets/generated/ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/chess-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png.
The updated icon images are visually realistic/modern and render correctly in the "All Games" grid cards without layout breakage.

file_operations.description: Replace the existing Ludo icon asset with a modern, realistic square icon while keeping the exact filename/path.
Replace the existing Chess icon asset with a modern, realistic square icon while keeping the exact filename/path.
Replace the existing Carrom icon asset with a modern, realistic square icon while keeping the exact filename/path.

Adjust the 'All Games' card image presentation (e.g., object-fit, overlays) as needed to ensure the updated realistic icons render cleanly without layout regressions, while keeping the referenced icon paths unchanged and not reintroducing Cricket.

requirements.summary: Update Quick Play visuals to match the reference by using the realistic image icons instead of Lucide icons, while preserving text and onSelectGame behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: Quick Play buttons still navigate correctly using the existing onSelectGame(game) flow for ludo/chess/carrom.
Quick Play tiles display image icons for Ludo/Chess/Carrom (using the existing generated icon assets) rather than Lucide icons.
The Quick Play section keeps English user-facing text (e.g., "Quick Play" and "Jump straight into your favorite game").
Quick Play layout remains a 3-item grid and stays visually consistent across common breakpoints (mobile/tablet/desktop).

file_operations.description: Replace Lucide vector icons with image-based icons using the existing generated assets (/assets/generated/ludo-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/chess-icon.dim_512x512.png, /assets/generated/carrom-icon.dim_512x512.png), keep current titles/subtitle text, preserve onSelectGame(game) behavior, and tune responsive styling to match the uploaded reference while maintaining a 3-item grid.
Add or adjust non-UI-component global utility styles (if needed) to support the updated Quick Play tile look (spacing, borders, shadows) without modifying any files under frontend/src/components/ui.
